The '''T7''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] series used in the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], especially during the [[Great Galactic War]].

During the Great Galactic War, a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] named [[Nico Okarr]] was in possession of [[T7-O1|one]] such droid, which would later become possession of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as [[Hero of Tython]].

Around the year [[3643 BBY]], combat upgrades that were available to the T7-series were manufactured on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and considered by some to be of the finest quality available.
